name: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
summary: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty is an official contract issued by Deputy Rainer at Westbrook Garrison to cull the encroaching gnolls threatening Elwynn Forest's western borders. The Stormwind Army offers a reward for painted armbands taken from the Riverpaw packs infesting the woods and waterways.

sections.title: A Threat on the Border
sections.body: Westbrook Garrison guards the critical borderlands between Elwynn Forest and Westfall. However, depleted garrison forces have left the outpost struggling to contain an aggressive influx of Riverpaw gnolls. These savage creatures have established encampments directly south of the guard tower and further east around the shores of Stone Cairn Lake, encroaching close enough to threaten peaceful travelers and local homesteads.

sections.title: The Price of Order
sections.body: Unable to spare regular infantry to sweep the woods, Deputy Rainer places a bounty on the raiders. To confirm the kills, Rainer requires proof of martial victory: painted gnoll armbands stripped from the slain beasts. By hiring wandering adventurers and recruits to thin the pack's numbers, the garrison hopes to blunt the Riverpaws' advance before they overrun the western marches.

faq.q: Where can Riverpaw gnolls be found in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls gather primarily in two areas in Elwynn: in the dense woods directly south of Westbrook Garrison near the riverbanks, and farther east around the perimeter of Stone Cairn Lake.

faq.q: Why is the garrison asking adventurers for help with gnolls?
faq.answer: Westbrook Garrison is understaffed and facing pressure along the borders of Elwynn. With too few guards to patrol the perimeter and simultaneously launch offensive sweeps, Deputy Rainer turns to independent champions to hunt the gnolls.

faq.q: What proof does Deputy Rainer require?
faq.answer: Deputy Rainer requires eight Painted Gnoll Armbands as physical proof that the encroaching beasts have been put down.

The Riverpaws are a notoriously vicious tribe of hyena-like humanoids known for infesting river valleys and borders across human lands. They frequently raid settlements, travelers, and farmlands for food and plunder.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to any other threats in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty is the conclusion of the short Westbrook Garrison alert chain, though Deputy Rainer and Westbrook Garrison also monitor other lawless elements in the area, such as the notorious outlaw Hogger.

faq.q: Who pays the bounty for these gnolls?
faq.answer: The bounty is officially sanctioned and backed by the Stormwind Army, which authorizes local garrisons to commend and compensate those who assist in pacifying royal territories.

angles.text: For humans of the realm, hunting down the Riverpaws is a direct effort to protect Elwynn's frontiers and support the overextended crown guards.
Taking on border bounties builds standing with the Stormwind Army while securing vital trade routes through the heart of the kingdom.
